LESSON: SLAVERY AND SERVITUDE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Slavery and Servitude
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Slavery and Servitude, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why has slavery and servitude existed for thousands of years?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Slavery and Servitude together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love: learners develop empathy and compassion as they discuss using well-articulated signs various social injustices committed on

the Africans during Indian Ocean slave trade in 15th century.

● Responsibility: learners develop accountability as they use and care for print or digital resources to conduct a research on the

organization of the Indian Ocean Slave trade.

Link to other learning Areas:

● English, Kiswahili and Kenyan Sign Language: learners brainstorm on the forms of slavery and servitude.

● Pre -Technical: learner relate to computer skill as they use digital devices to research on the organisation of Indian Ocean slave trade.

Suggested Learning Resource:

digital resources, flip charts/manila papers, maps, approved text books,
